objective: PATH-I 先冻结并 fixture-验证真实 C1 所需的 trial-return 上游、长期 identity、四组件部署与六类授权合同；不实现真实运行，信号只保留边界和 8 个最小字段。
verified_facts: CR-163 lineage store 只保存 family/trial metadata 与 artifact refs，不保存 trial return series。
现有 mature multifactor runner 是单次研究运行，不是 multi-trial parameter sweep。
现有 layered_returns.csv 是因子分层 forward return，不是 trial 级 return series。
CR-173 v1 消费已计算的 dependency matrix R，不从 raw return series 计算 R。
CR-172 five-field contract 只覆盖有限数据湖只读范围，不覆盖 multi-trial runtime、研究工作区写、NAS sync 或执行机 pull/materialize。
用户确认研究机本地目录是数据湖、实验/回测报告和 trial returns 的实际运行路径与 active canonical；NAS 保存同步副本、备份并作为执行机数据分发来源。
执行机需要离线研究/数据湖对象时，必须从 NAS 拉取并校验到本地目录后再消费，不直接把 NAS 当 runtime 工作盘。
交易信号默认应由执行机基于批准策略包本地生成；低频/EOD 才可使用 NAS immutable mailbox，intraday 需要独立实时传输能力。

recommended_route.activation_after: 只有上游合同、owner、分动作授权、five fields、stable URI、部署映射和 fresh precheck 全部就绪后，才重开 PATH-C/A。
not_authorized: source or test implementation before future CP5 approval

path_contract.legacy_policy: read-only audit reference; no move, rename or manifest rewrite in this delta
path_contract.identity_rule: lineage stores logical URI plus content hash; host absolute mount path is deployment mapping only

deployment_components.research_machine: GitHub checkout/uv/runtime workspace and active-canonical local data/research directories; versioned hash/manifest sync to NAS after authorization
deployment_components.trading_machine: consume approved package and local materialized data; generate trading signals locally by default; write separate local/trading archive
deployment_components.nas: verified replica, backup and cross-machine distribution surface with isolated data-lake, research, package-exchange, conditional signal-exchange and trading-archive zones
deployment_components.github: code, schema, docs, manifest/hash/pointer and release metadata only; no real datasets, returns, credentials or account/order payloads

signal_transfer.default: no research-to-execution signal transfer; execution machine generates signals locally from approved strategy package and local data
signal_transfer.low_frequency: PATH-I only freezes an optional immutable SignalBatch/TargetPositionBatch boundary and 8 minimal fields; it does not design or implement the mailbox
signal_transfer.deferred: physical mailbox paths, seven-stage state machine, ack, idempotency/replay and transport implementation
signal_transfer.intraday: out of base four-component topology; requires independent realtime transport CR with mTLS, ordered delivery, ack/replay and failover
signal_transfer.forbidden: credentials, account secrets and broker order commands are never transported in SignalBatch

review_boundaries.cp3: design-only; no directory creation, runner change, NAS write, multi-trial run or signal transfer
review_boundaries.cp5: future approval may authorize repository-local code/test/fixture only; all six real actions remain unauthorized

follow_up_links.FU-CR173-001: empirical dependency-matrix methodology v2; hard prerequisite for positive empirical effective count/C1 computable, not for DQ-003 degraded design
follow_up_links.DF-CR172-SIGNAL-BATCH-EXCHANGE: detailed low-frequency mailbox design and implementation
